282812386.description:
Collectible Rock and Mineral Specimen Lot
7 Pieces Including Polished Stone Egg and Rough Slabs
Natural Stone and Mineral Specimens
This diverse lapidary and mineral specimen lot features seven natural stone pieces suitable for display, study, or crafting. The grouping includes a polished red and orange marbled stone egg alongside an assortment of rough, raw, and slab specimens showcasing varied mineral textures and formations.
Items Included:
One polished stone egg with red and orange marbling, measuring approximately 2 inches long
Two red and earthy jasper or petrified wood slab sections with natural weathered rinds
One druzy mineral plate featuring fine sparkling microcrystalline surface coverage
Two grey semi-translucent chalcedony and flint fragments with conchoidal fractures
One tan and brown banded stone specimen block
Condition:
All items are in pre-owned condition. The polished egg displays a smooth glossy surface with natural internal fissure lines. The rough rock and slab specimens exhibit natural rough textures, raw fracture edges, surface inclusions, and earth matrix consistent with unpolished geological specimens.
Thank you for all of your support!

Walt Disney Collectables
Mickey Mouse Through the Years 6 Souvenir Pens
National Pen Corporation, Circa 1986
Vintage Walt Disney Collectables six-piece souvenir pen set manufactured in the United States by National Pen Corporation. Produced around 1986 during the transition from Walt Disney Productions to The Walt Disney Company, this commemorative set highlights the artistic evolution of Mickey Mouse across six signature animation eras.
Complete set of six souvenir pens featuring Mickey Mouse designs from 1928, 1936, 1941, 1947, 1955, and 1986
Manufactured in the USA by National Pen Corporation with chrome-tone pocket clips marked USA National Pen
Front display card bears original Walt Disney Productions copyright, while pen barrels feature The Walt Disney Company copyright
Housed in original hanging blister display case measuring approximately 6.8 by 6.4 inches
Condition:
Unopened in original plastic blister case. Packaging displays age-appropriate yellowing, light scuffing, and an original $7.50 retail price sticker on the reverse. Pens are preserved in place; writing functionality is untested and ink cartridges may be dried due to vintage age.
